task.text: Sorry for the delay, brother. Everything was put on hold because Arden did not like the quality or the offer. We have now created a new, more detailed offer that you can check: complete only 8 perfectg clips, and then I’ll hire you for 900$ to produce 180 approved clips per month. After that, I’ll train you as the lead clipper at $4500 a month.
